KinesioCal Automatic Renewal Terms

Last updated 11/09/2026

These terms are shown in the app and accepted every time a business starts or changes a paid plan. They sit under the Provider Terms of Service; if the two disagree, Section 6 of the Provider Terms of Service governs.

1. What you are buying

A KinesioCal plan is a monthly subscription: the plan you pick plus any extra therapist seats, at the prices shown in the plan picker when you accept these terms. The picker shows the total you will be charged each month. If you entered a promotion code, it also shows your first invoice and the price that bills once the promotion ends.

2. Your plan renews automatically

Your subscription renews every month until you cancel it. Each renewal charges the card on file (or the payment method you gave our payment processor, Stripe) for the next month, in advance, on your billing date. You will not be asked again before each charge; this acceptance covers every renewal until you cancel or change the plan.

Prices can change on 30 days' notice by email, and a new price applies from your first renewal after the notice period, as described in Section 6.2 of the Terms of Service.

3. Changing your plan or seats

  • Moving to a higher plan, or adding seats, takes effect immediately; Stripe prorates the difference on your next invoice.
  • Moving to a lower plan, or removing seats, takes effect when the period you have paid for ends. You keep the current plan and seats until then, and nothing is prorated or credited.
  • Every start or change of a plan asks you to accept these terms again, because each is a new purchase decision.

4. How to cancel

Cancel at any time from Settings → Account → Cancel in the app. You will be asked to type the word cancel so it cannot happen by accident. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you have paid for: you keep full access until then, nothing further is charged, and nothing is refunded. A confirmation email states the exact last day. Until that day, Keep my plan on the same page reverses the cancellation. After it ends, signing in opens your Account page, where you can pick a plan again; nothing is deleted.

Cancelling in the app is the only way to stop renewals. There is no cancellation by phone, email, or through Stripe's receipt pages.

5. Pausing instead

You may pause your plan for one or two months from the same page. The pause begins when your paid period ends, so every paid day is used; while paused, your account is locked to the Account page and nothing is charged. The plan resumes by itself at the end of the pause, with a reminder two days before. Resuming, early or on time, charges a full month that day and moves your billing date to it.

6. If a payment fails

Stripe retries the charge and we tell you by email and in the app. You then have a 3-day grace period with full access. After it, every sign-in opens your Account page until the payment goes through; your billing date does not move, and a late payment covers the period that began on it. Fees are non-refundable; billing adjustments are handled under Section 6.3 and 6.5 of the Terms of Service.

7. Your record of this acceptance

When you tick the box and continue, we record the version of these terms you accepted, your account, the date and time, and your IP address. Stripe emails a receipt for every charge, and Settings → Account → Payment history lists every invoice. Questions about billing go to KinesioCalendar@gmail.com.
